Used them a few times over the years, but would not recommend unless you get Adam as your plumber. Every other time we have had them in, there has been an issue needing corrected. Today, I called to see if someone can check out our sump pump (I think it needs a new check valve) and was told that there is nothing that can be fixed with sump pumps and that they just replace them. I'm very confused by this because you can replace a check valve without replacing the sump pump. Completely lost trust in them after that phone call. Would not recommend.
In the past, we've hired them for toilet replacement, bidet installs, kitchen faucet install, and shower head replacements.

text.text: Excellent service for some small plumbing work I needed to be done in our middle bathroom. Work done included new shutoff valves for the sink plus installation of new faucet and a check on a running toilet (turned out to be just a new flapper). Very easy to schedule the appointment and the service guys were quick and very professional. Great price on the final bill. This should be anyone's go-to plumbing service.
